title: turingnet.verdict.v1
description: Machine verdict emitted by scripts/redact_pii.py --json (schema turingnet.redaction.v1), scripts/guard.py --json (schema turingnet.guard.v1) and scripts/low_bandwidth_report.py --json (schema turingnet.report.v1). The 'schema' field discriminates the emitter; the common envelope is described here. Exit codes: redactor 0 clean / 1 input error / 2 residual suspicion; guard 0 pass / 1 warn / 2 block / 3 input error; report 0 built / 1 input error / 2 guard-blocked.

replacements.description: redactor: replacement counts by PII type (phone-ir, national-id-ir, imei, imsi, iccid-sim, bank-pan, iban-ir, ipv4, ipv6, mac, bearer-token, secret-assign, aws-key, gps, email).
